_help: Creatures for familiars, companions and summons (Companions panel on the sheet). 'cr' can be 0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5 or 1-30. 'speed' uses "30 ft." style text. Actions with 'attack' (to-hit bonus) and 'damage' (dice like 1d8+2) become clickable rolls. Beasts can also be used for Wild Shape.

traits.name: Keen Nose
traits.description: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, reach 5 ft. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Prone condition.

traits.name: Glow
traits.description: Sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius.

actions.name: Soothe
actions.description: One creature within 30 ft. regains 1d4 Hit Points. No roll is needed for this action.
